name: Alloy Grotesk
classification_notes: A confident, heavyweight grotesque sans with the tight spacing and solid strokes typical of workhorse display grotesques, shown paired with a matching slab companion.
summary: A bold, solid grotesque sans released alongside its slab-serif sibling Alloy Slab.
description: Alloy Grotesk is a heavyweight sans with tight, confident letterforms built for headline and identity use rather than long text. It forms a superfamily pair with Alloy Slab, sharing the same underlying proportions in a serif cut.
foundry_blurb: Kirjatehnika lists Alloy Grotesk as part of its working collection of typefaces, available for licensing as a beta version alongside a full PDF specimen.

name: Alloy Slab
classification_notes: The slab-serif companion to Alloy Grotesk, carrying the same bold, solid proportions into a serifed structure with heavy, unbracketed feet.
summary: The slab-serif half of the Alloy pair, keeping the same bold, solid proportions as Alloy Grotesk.
description: Alloy Slab takes the sturdy, tightly spaced letterforms of Alloy Grotesk and adds heavy, unbracketed slab feet, giving the pair a shared identity across sans and serif use in headline and branding work.
foundry_blurb: Kirjatehnika lists Alloy Slab as part of its working collection of typefaces, available for licensing as a beta version alongside a full PDF specimen.

name: Bougie
classification_notes: An elegant serif with noticeable thick-thin contrast and refined curves, closer to a fashion-oriented display serif than a workhorse text face.
summary: An elegant, high-contrast serif with a refined, faintly fashion-editorial character.
description: Bougie pairs generous contrast between thick and thin strokes with confident curves, giving it a polished, slightly formal air suited to fashion and lifestyle branding rather than dense text.
foundry_blurb: Kirjatehnika lists Bougie as part of its working collection of typefaces, available for licensing as a beta version alongside a full PDF specimen.

name: Frukt
classification_notes: A blocky, unicase geometric display face mixing capital and lowercase-style shapes into a single case, built for character rather than legibility at text sizes.
summary: A blocky unicase display face that mixes up letterform conventions for a distinctly playful, geometric look.
description: Frukt trades a conventional upper and lower case for a single, chunky unicase set built from simple geometric shapes, aimed squarely at display and branding rather than running text.
foundry_blurb: Kirjatehnika lists Frukt as part of its working collection of typefaces, available for licensing as a beta version alongside a full PDF specimen.

name: Goofy
classification_notes: A display face pitched at a lighthearted, informal register, in keeping with its name, rather than a serious text or grotesque structure.
summary: A lighthearted display face built for informal, characterful branding work.
description: Goofy leans into an informal, cartoonish register, in keeping with its name, and is best suited to playful branding and headline use rather than neutral text setting.
foundry_blurb: Kirjatehnika lists Goofy as part of its working collection of typefaces, available for licensing as a beta version alongside a full PDF specimen.

name: Ladna Sans
classification_notes: A straightforward grotesque sans, positioned by its name as a general-purpose text and display companion within Kirjatehnika's small catalogue.
summary: A general-purpose grotesque sans within Kirjatehnika's small, beta-stage catalogue.
description: Ladna Sans fills the plain, workhorse grotesque slot in Kirjatehnika's catalogue, built for straightforward text and branding use alongside the foundry's more characterful display faces.
foundry_blurb: Kirjatehnika lists Ladna Sans as part of its working collection of typefaces, available for licensing as a beta version alongside a full PDF specimen.

name: Metropol
classification_notes: A grotesque sans with a city-branding name and register, positioned for identity and signage work rather than long-form text.
summary: A grotesque sans built with an urban, city-branding register in mind.
description: Metropol takes its name and general disposition from city branding and signage, offering a grotesque sans suited to identity work over long-form text.
foundry_blurb: Kirjatehnika lists Metropol as part of its working collection of typefaces, available for licensing as a beta version alongside a full PDF specimen.
